name: How long does a typical natural stone tile installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical natural stone tile installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical residential natural stone tile installation takes between 3 to 7 working days, depending on room size and project scope. The process involves multiple mandatory curing steps that cannot be rushed. Day one usually covers subfloor reinforcement and membrane installation. Laying the stone and making precision cuts typically takes one to two days. The thin-set mortar then requires a full 24 hours to cure before grouting. After grouting, another curing period is necessary before the final penetrating sealer and perimeter silicone caulking are applied. Larger bathrooms with intricate patterns or custom shower pans naturally add time to the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most natural stone installations take 3 to 7 working days, accounting for subfloor prep, laying stone, mortar curing, grouting, and final sealing.
